nodes.description: uint64 contract state variable _seed initialized to 0, used both as entropy input and as pseudo-random output.
Public function random(uint64 upper) that derives a new _seed from blockhash, previous seed and now, then returns _seed % upper.
Input parameter upper of random(), used as the modulus of _seed and as the upper bound of the returned pseudo-random number.
now / block.timestamp, miner-influenced value hashed into the seed, making the pseudo-randomness predictable and manipulable.
Modulo operation _seed % upper: arithmetic hazard, reverts with division-by-zero when upper == 0 and has no lower-bound validation.
Seed derivation _seed = uint64(sha3(sha3(blockhash(block.number), _seed), now)): weak on-chain randomness dependent on blockhash and block.timestamp.
Named return variable randomNumber holding the pseudo-random result of the modulo operation.

edges.reason: Parameter upper flows directly into the modulo _seed % upper, so a zero or attacker-chosen value triggers division-by-zero or bounds manipulation.
Parameter upper is consumed by the function random() to bound the returned value.
block.timestamp (now) is hashed into the seed, giving timestamp/miner influence over the generated random number.
The current state variable _seed is read as input to the sha3 seed derivation.
The result of the sha3 seed derivation is written back into the state variable _seed.
The updated state variable _seed is read as the dividend of the modulo operation.
The modulo result is bound to the named return variable randomNumber.
The modulo result is returned from the random() function execution path.
Execution of random() mutates the contract state variable _seed.

normalization_plan.reason: Parameter upper is a non-core node whose only security-relevant use is as the modulus operand of the unsafe modulo operation, so it is absorbed into the operation node.
Local variable randomNumber is the return slot of the function and carries no independent security semantics, so it is merged into the enclosing core function node.
